items.title: Kazatomprom operations chief detained in bribery probe
items.author: Northern Miner Staff
items.creator: Henry Lazenby
items.summary: The uranium miner said its board removed Omarbekov and chief commercial officer Vladislav Baiguzhin and reassigned their duties.
items.body:
Kazatomprom operations chief detained in bribery probe
The uranium miner said its board removed Omarbekov and chief commercial officer Vladislav Baiguzhin and reassigned their duties.

Henry Lazenby
|
November 25, 2026 - 3:36 pm

Categories:
Asia
Canada
News
stock-markets-investing
Uranium

A Kazatomprom uranium exploration site in Kazakhstan. Credit: Kazatomprom

Kazakhstan’s anti-corruption service detained Kazatomprom’s (LSE: KAP) head of operations as a bribery investigation widened from the country’s sovereign wealth fund to the world’s largest uranium miner.

Officers detained Kuanysh Omarbekov and others Monday, the National Security Committee said Wednesday. Investigators suspect them of involvement in a corruption scheme allegedly organized by former leaders of state investment fund Samruk-Kazyna. The fund managed $88 billion in assets at the end of 2025 and owns 63% of Kazatomprom.

The miner said its board removed Omarbekov and chief commercial officer Vladislav Baiguzhin on Tuesday and reassigned their duties to other managers.

“The company reassures that its production and commercial teams at operational levels remain intact with ongoing business and day-to-day operations continuing as usual,” Kazatomprom said Wednesday.

The detentions deepen a corruption investigation into Kazakhstan’s state-owned businesses, raising questions about oversight at companies central to the country’s economy and international mineral supply chains.

Kazatomprom’s global depositary receipts fell nearly 10% to close at $49.80 in London on Wednesday, valuing the company at $12.9 billion.

Large scale

Omarbekov oversaw exploration, drilling, mining and processing for a company whose share of production accounted for about one-fifth of the world’s mined uranium last year. Kazatomprom expects the operations in which it holds stakes to produce 27,500–29,000 tonnes of uranium this year, including 14,500–15,500 tonnes for its own account.

The committee is investigating under a provision of Kazakhstan’s criminal code that covers giving a bribe on an especially large scale or by a criminal group. It withheld further details, citing rules on pretrial investigations.

Kazatomprom said it was cooperating with investigators. Omarbekov ran KAP Logistics, Kazatomprom’s procurement and transport arm, from 2018 to 2022. He then led Akbastau, a uranium mining venture in southern Kazakhstan owned equally by Kazatomprom and Rosatom’s Uranium One, before becoming operations chief in June 2023.

Uranium deliveries

Kazatomprom’s share of uranium output rose 12% to 10,969 tonnes in the first nine months of the year. Its Canadian partner Cameco (TSX: CCO; NYSE: CCJ) owns 40% of the Inkai mine in southern Kazakhstan. Kazatomprom owns the rest.

Cameco said in its third-quarter results that it expected to buy 4.2 million lb. of uranium oxide from Inkai’s projected output of 10.4 million lb. this year. By the time Cameco reported on Oct. 30, a shipment carrying 1.6 million lb. of its share had reached the Blind River refinery in Ontario. The final shipment was en route and due before year-end.

Fund’s tungsten deal

The anti-corruption service had already detained the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and the national railway on Nov. 11. Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov, who chairs the fund’s board of directors, called on Nov. 18 for tighter oversight of the fund and its subsidiaries, particularly by their audit and risk committees.

“This is an extremely serious signal of large-scale corruption in state-owned companies,” President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev told Kazakhstan’s Security Council on Nov. 13, referring to the detentions of the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and the national railway.

The fund’s then-chief, Nurlan Zhakupov, witnessed the signing in February of agreements between its mining company, Tau-Ken Samruk, and U.S.-based Cove Kaz Capital Group. Cove committed at least $1.1 billion to develop the Northern Katpar and Upper Kairakty tungsten deposits and process the metal in Kazakhstan.

The security committee’s statements on the November detentions identify no tungsten transaction as part of the alleged scheme.

US financing scrutiny

The venture drew scrutiny in Washington because U.S. President Donald Trump’s sons, Donald Jr. and Eric, hold an indirect stake. U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren questioned in July how the U.S. Export-Import Bank would protect taxpayers from conflicts of interest. The Trump Organization told Fox News the brothers were passive investors and had no advance knowledge of the award.

The Export-Import Bank and the U.S. International Development Finance Corp. had expressed interest in providing up to $1.6 billion between them. Reuters reported Nov. 10 that neither lender was actively pursuing the financing. Cove said it had yet to apply.

BERLIN: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz accused Russia on Wednesday (Nov 25) of "escalating" threats to European security as he defended his government's plans to bolster defence spending and maintain financial aid to Ukraine.
Opposition parties, including t he far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD), which tops national opinion polls, and t he hard-left Die Linke, have called for an end to military aid to Kyiv .
"It cannot be s aid often enough, against t he far right as much as t he far left: Russia knows exactly what it wants . And Russia wants more than Ukraine," Merz told t he Bundestag lower house of parliament during a debate on t he 2027 draft budget.
"Russia is escalating in t he Baltic region, in Poland, on t he Black Sea; Russia is escalating in space, and Russia is by now also escalating massively he re in our own country," he s aid .

Russia did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on Merz 's accusations. It has repeatedly denied seeking military confrontation with NATO countries and says its actions in Ukraine are aimed at protecting its own national security.
Merz 's government blamed Russia in September for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle airport , an accusation t he Russian Embassy in Berlin dismissed as part of a "new wave of anti-Russian hysteria in Germany".
Germany and ot he r European countries have also been hit by a wave of cyberattacks and sabotage incidents targeting critical infrastructure that t he y have often blamed on Russia. Moscow has denied all t he allegations.

"LEARNING FROM UKRAINE" Merz s aid on Wednesday that by supporting Ukraine, Germany was also protecting itself.
"We are learning from Ukraine - technologically for civilian use but of course also in defence technology," he s aid .
Germany has been Ukraine's biggest military backer in Europe since Russia's full-blown invasion on Feb 24, 2022, but public support for this policy has decreased amid cost-of-living pressures. A poll publis he d on Tuesday showed a narrow majority of Germans now oppose giving military aid to Kyiv .
"Whose chancellor are you, actually?" AfD co-leader Tino Chrupalla asked Merz during Wednesday's debate, accusing the government of supporting Ukraine while failing to provide sufficient relief to German citizens. "What a mockery!"
Germany aims to double defence spending to over €200 billion (US$228 billion) between now and 2030, according to t he 2027 draft budget, hitting 3.7 per cent of national output by 2030, in line with commitments to NATO.

EU SHOULD FOCUS ON SECURITY AND COMPETITIVENESS, MERZ SAYS Merz also addressed on Wednesday t he latest proposal for t he European Union budget for 2028-2034 presented by European Council chief Antonio Costa.
Costa proposed cuts that would reduce t he overall seven-year budget to €1.582 trillion, some €40 billion less than a proposal presented by t he Irish EU presidency in October.
EU leaders will discuss Costa's proposals at a special summit on Thursday and Friday.
"In t he se negotiations I am pushing for spending to be limited and focused on what really makes Europe stronger: security and competitiveness," Merz s aid . "If spending is focused, it is t he best additional insurance for our country."

items.title: Loonie jumps as Macklem stays hawkish
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: The Canadian dollar jumped higher than it has in more than three months on Tuesday, as the Bank of Canada (BoC) signalled that it’s still worried about persistent inflation, which is also being felt ...
items.body: The Canadian dollar jumped higher than it has in more than three months on Tuesday, as the Bank of Canada (BoC) signalled that it’s still worried about persistent inflation, which is also being felt south of the border. With inflation running hot in both Canada and the U.S., largely due to months of elevated global oil prices, markets have priced in rate hikes from both the BoC and U.S. Federal Reserve at their next respective meetings. “The loonie follows the interest rate differentials,” Rahim Madhavji, president of Knightsbridge Foreign Exchange, told BNN Bloomberg on Wednesday. “If the BoC and the Fed raise rates in tandem, that generally bodes well for the loonie.” Bank of Canada governor Tiff Macklem said on Tuesday in a speech at the Economic Club of Canada in Toronto that he expects “more pass-through to consumer prices in the year ahead,” despite the oil price relief seen in recent weeks. “This second-round effect of the oil shock will add to inflation persistence,” he said in prepared remarks, suggesting the BoC is prepared to raise rates for a second straight time next month in an effort to tame inflationary pressures. “The BoC with the speech yesterday basically has said: ‘Look, we’re going to raise rates.’ That differential has caught up, and that’s why the loonie basically repriced as a result of that interest rate differential,” Madhavji said. The Canadian dollar was up 0.49 per cent to more than 70 cents US in midday trading on Wednesday. Loonie supported by trade talks The signing of a new trade deal between Canada and the U.S. is another factor that would positively impact the Canadian dollar, according to Madhavji. “I think an announcement of a firm trade deal would be beneficial for Canada and would be beneficial for the loonie. It would be beneficial for certainty in businesses and investment going down the line,” he said. “The uncertainty and the lack of a trade deal is hurting the Canadian dollar. So, the fact that there’s been noise that we’re close to a deal, almost have a deal, looking for a fair deal; that bodes well for the loonie.” Trade talks between Canada and the U.S. have been taking place for months but seem to have heated up in recent weeks. U.S. President Donald Trump’s chief trade representative said on Wednesday that negotiations with Canada are continuing, but the two sides remain stuck on a few pressure points including around steel, aluminum and autos. “We want to make sure that North American trade in these products is beneficial to the United States. Obviously, there would have to be something that accommodates Canada as well,” said U.S. Trade Rep. Jamieson Greer in morning interview on CNBC. Greer’s comments came after yet another round of proposed U.S. tariffs, announced by the Trump administration Wednesday, targeting major trading partners including China, the European Union and Japan over subsidized production. Canada was not among them. “Until a deal is made, we basically have to keep waiting and seeing what’s exactly going to happen. We’re always one tweet away from some other type of news event, or increased tariffs, or a renegotiation or repricing of something,” Madhavji said. “So, you really need a firm deal, and people need to believe that the deal is going to be in place and that it’s firm, but a trade deal obviously benefits the Canadian dollar.” With files from CTV News’ Luca Caruso-Moro, The Canadian Press and The Associated Press

items.body:
欧州市場サマリー（25日）
4:50 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞　続落して取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に続落した。銀行や鉱業株の売り注文が優勢だった一方、景気変動の影響を受けにくい銘柄が物色され、相場を下支えした。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．９３％安だった。銀行大手スタンダード・チャータードは４．７％、ライオン・ファイナンス・グループは４．２％それぞれ下落した。金の値下がりを受けて、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は２．９１％安。航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．７８％安。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは３．９％下落した。一方、生活必需品株指数は１．２３％高。日用品のレキット・ベンキーザーは１．３％上昇。ユニリーバは米マコーミックとの統合に関する英競争当局の見解が前向きなものとして好材料視され、２．２％値上がりした。たばこのインペリアル・ブランズは６．１％高。モルガン・スタンレーによる目標株価の引き上げを受けて、買われた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　続落して取引を終えた。銀行やハイテク株の売り注文が目立った。利上げ観測の高まりや米関税措置を巡る不透明感、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連を巡る先行き懸念が相場の重荷となった。ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は３．３２％、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は２．９６％それぞれ下落した。テクノロジー株指数は３．１１％安。オランダのハイテク投資会社プロサス は４．９％値下がりした。一方、自動車・部品株指数は１．４８％上昇。ＪＰモルガンによる強気のリポートを受けて、ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は３．４％、ＢＭＷは３．７％それぞれ上昇した。業績予想を上方修正したフランスの蒸留酒メーカー、レミー・コアントローは１３．１％上昇した。１０月の米コア個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年同月比の伸びが市場予想を上回った。これを受けて、１２月の米利上げ観測が高まった。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１２月会合で利上げするとの見方が強い。米政権は主要貿易相手国・地域に新たな関税措置を提案。欧州連合（ＥＵ）は、米国との間で合意した関税率上限１５％と整合するものになるとの認識を示した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　域内国債利回りが低下した。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への売りが続いて米主要株価指数が急落し、投資家が相対的に安全な国債に資金を移した。域内の指標となるドイツ１０年債利回りは４．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、３．２２％となった。一時は１１月６日以来の低水準を付けた。ドイツ２年債利回りは４．５ｂｐ低下の３．０２％。半導体大手エヌビディア のジェンスン・フアン氏が２３日に最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰したことで株価は上昇したが、ＡＩを巡る疑念はくすぶっている。米議員からは同氏の再任を批判する声が上がった。フランス１０年債利回りは４．５ｂｐ、イタリア１０年債利回りは３．５ｂｐ低下した。短期金融市場ではＥＣＢの利上げ観測が後退。２０２７年７月までに織り込まれた金融引き締め幅は、２３日の約６０ｂｐから直近では約５５ｂｐに縮小した。

items.title: エヌビディア、Ｓ＆Ｐが格下げ方向で見直し　ＣＥＯ復帰で企業統治に懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anhata Rooprai

[２５日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングは２５日、米半導体大手エヌビディ...
items.body:
エヌビディア、Ｓ＆Ｐが格下げ方向で見直し　ＣＥＯ復帰で企業統治に懸念
4:39 配信

11月23日、米カリフォルニア州サンタクララのエヌビディア本社前で撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria（ロイター） Anhata Rooprai

[２５日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングは２５日、米半導体大手エヌビディアの信用格付けを引き下げ方向で見直す「クレジット・ウオッチ・ネガティブ」に指定した。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任とその後の復帰によって、経営と取締役会の監督機能の弱さが露呈したと指摘した。

Ｓ＆Ｐは「一部の取締役の在任期間が長いことで、独立性が損なわれている可能性があると考える。エヌビディアの急成長や世界の重要なテクノロジー基盤としての役割に、企業統治（コーポレートガバナンス）の慣行が追いついていない可能性もある」とした。

エヌビディアの経営陣を巡る混乱が続く中での措置となった。同社の取締役会は今週初め、フアン氏をＣＥＯに復帰させた。同氏は、直属の部下らや、米情報機関が中国政府のスパイと疑う中国人実業家との不倫関係が発覚し、今月上旬に辞任していた。

フアン氏の復帰を巡っては議員らからも取締役会の独立性に疑問の声が上がった。取締役会で新たに選出された議長は先週、フアン氏の個人的な行為が会社の行動規範に反するとして、同氏をＣＥＯに再任することはないと投資家に説明していた。

エヌビディアは２３日にフアン氏の復帰を発表した際、不倫関係には一切言及せず、決定は「米政府の見解に基づく」と説明した。一方、独立した取締役会委員会は、同氏と外国情報機関による活動の疑いに関する報道について調査を続けていた。

ロイターは２５日、事情に詳しい関係者３人の話として、トランプ大統領がフアン氏のＣＥＯ復帰を働きかける前に、米司法省は同氏に対する正式な捜査を実施していなかったと報じた。

司法省は代わりに、エヌビディアの顧客であるスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターとメガスピード・インターナショナルに対する捜査を基に、フアン氏が法律に違反した証拠はないと判断した。両社には先端半導体を中国に密輸した疑いがある。

エヌビディアの現在の格付けは「ＡＡ」で、これは財務上の債務を履行する能力が非常に高いことを示す。最上位の格付けは「ＡＡＡ」。

Ｓ＆Ｐは今後９０日以内に格下げする可能性があるとした。ただ、調査やその他の情報開示によって同社の評判や将来の事業見通しに悪影響が及ばない限り、エヌビディアに対する格下げは１段階にとどまると見込んでいる。

一方、ムーディーズは２５日、フアン氏の復帰によってエヌビディアの事業遂行を巡る短期的な不確実性が和らぎ、新たな経営トップの起用に伴う事業遂行上のリスクが解消されると指摘した。

同社の格付け「Ａａ１」と「安定的」な見通しに変更はないとしたが、企業統治と規制を巡る不確実性は残ると述べた。

＜アリス・フアン氏がスパイとの証拠、現時点で見つからず＞

米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は２５日、米情報機関の説明に詳しい関係者の話として、ハイテク企業幹部のアリス・フアン氏が中国政府の指示を受けてジェンスン・フアン氏に対してスパイ活動を行ったことを示す証拠を、米当局は確認していないと報じた。

中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）、連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）、国家情報長官室（ＯＤＮＩ）、国家安全保障局（ＮＳＡ）の当局者が、上下両院の情報委員会と議会指導部のスタッフに説明したという。

エヌビディアと各機関は、ロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。ロイターはこの報道を独自に確認できていない。

items.title: 米景気は緩やかな拡大続く、インフレ高止まり＝地区連銀報告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２５日公表した地区連銀経済報告（ベージュブック）によると、経済活動...
items.body:
米景気は緩やかな拡大続く、インフレ高止まり＝地区連銀報告
4:25 配信

2025年9月17日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno/File Photo（ロイター） [２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２５日公表した地区連銀経済報告（ベージュブック）によると、経済活動は大半の地区で「小幅から緩やかな」ペースで拡大を続け、雇用も増加した。一方、インフレ圧力は根強く残った。

物価は「前回の報告期間と同様、全体として緩やかに上昇した」とし、「幅広い業種の調査先から、エネルギー、輸送、医療、保険、関税関連の費用による持続的なコスト圧力が報告された」と説明した。

また、投入コストの上昇が販売価格の上昇を上回っており、企業の利益率への圧力が強まっていることを示唆した。「競争圧力と顧客の価格に対する敏感さが、コスト上昇を全面的に転嫁する企業の能力を制限した。企業は、費用と価格がともに今後数カ月間上昇を続けると予想した」という。

全米の全体像はまちまちで、８地区が成長を報告した一方、４地区は活動が横ばいとした。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームに主導された設備投資は引き続き堅調だったが、家計の余裕が一段と乏しくなり、より安価な商品への切り替えが進んだため、個人消費は横ばいだった。

ミネアポリス連銀は「ミシガン州北部の業務用家具業者は『顧客は今、より低価格の商品に目を向けている』と話した。ミネソタ州北西部の酒類小売店も『客数の伸びほど売上高は伸びておらず、消費者がより安価な商品に切り替えていることがうかがえる』と述べた」と報告した。

クリーブランド連銀は、活況を呈するＡＩ関連活動の継続的な影響を指摘した。「製造品需要は力強く増加し、その勢いは依然としてデータセンターの建設、発電、防衛に集中している。旺盛なデータセンター需要が半導体や電気部品の供給を逼迫（ひっぱく）させ、納期の長期化を招き、一部の顧客は在庫を確保するため大幅に前倒しで発注した」と述べた。

フィラデルフィア連銀は「小売業者（自動車を除く）からは、１０月下旬から１１月上旬の個人消費が、前回報告期間の小幅減少から一転して小幅に増加したとの報告があった。企業はこうしたセンチメントの改善を、ガソリン価格の低下と選挙の決着によるものだとした」という。

今回のベージュブックは、１１月１６日までに得られた回答を反映した。インフレと生活費負担に対する有権者の懸念が争点となった米中間選挙の前後の数週間を対象とした初めての報告書となった。中間選挙では民主党が上下両院の支配を奪還し、トランプ政権の政策に対する厳しい評価が浮き彫りとなった。ベージュブックの中で、中間選挙には約１２回の言及があった。

ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めると広く予想されている。ただ、ＡＩブームの持続性への懸念から株価が急落し、市場の利上げ観測は後退した。

items.title: Farmers sell paddy stubble to biomass firms, cut farm fires in Punjab
items.summary: The shift offers a potential solution to stubble burning, which has persisted despite years of government efforts to stamp it out ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / Agriculture / Farmers sell paddy stubble to biomass firms, cut farm fires in Punjab

Farmers sell paddy stubble to biomass firms, cut farm fires in Punjab The shift offers a potential solution to stubble burning, which has persisted despite years of government efforts to stamp it out

More Punjab farmers are finding that straw once treated as waste can generate income, reducing the incentive to burn it (Photo: Sarthak Choudhury)

Reuters SEDHA SINGH WALA 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 26 2026 | 8:12 AM IST

Listen to This Article

For years, 60-year-old farmer Rajinder Singh burned his paddy stubble after the harvest, one of thousands of fires across India's Punjab state each autumn. Now, his crop waste is trucked to a biomass plant, generating power and village incomes instead of smoke.
The shift offers a potential solution to stubble burning, which has persisted despite years of government efforts to stamp it out. Such fires have contributed to the toxic smog that blankets the capital Delhi and much of northern India each winter, making it one of the most polluted areas in the world.
"Our earnings have improved considerably through this work," Singh said, speaking in his Sedha Singh Wala village in Punjab. "Earlier we used to burn the stubble. Now many families are getting employment from it."
  More Punjab farmers are finding that straw once treated as waste can generate income, reducing the incentive to burn it.
Punjab recorded 5,114 farm fires during the 2025 paddy-harvesting season, down 53% from 2024 and 86% from 2023, according to government estimates.
Also Read

Shiromani Akali Dal back in NDA fold, to fight Punjab polls with BJP

Stubble burning numbers fall sharply, but satellite blind spots cloud data premium

Datanomics: Delhi's AQI improves after hitting 5-year high on Diwali premium

But the dramatic fall has yet to translate into noticeably cleaner air in Delhi. The capital's air quality again reached hazardous levels in mid-November this year, underscoring both the multiple sources of its pollution and the limited scale of the biomass industry.
"Biomass-based projects are financially sound and genuinely effective," said Pratima Singh, a director at policy and research firm iFOREST.
"But right now they're operating at a fraction of the scale needed, so their impact isn't yet visible in Delhi's air."
MORE INCOMES, JOBS In Punjab's Faridkot district, a network of farmers, machinery operators and biomass power producers have emerged to collect paddy straw and turn it into fuel for electricity generation.
Farmers and analysts say the business is also creating jobs, and boosting incomes, but government incentives are needed to expand it enough to make a meaningful dent.
Amandeep Singh Gill, who processes paddy straw into feedstock for power plants, provides work for tractor operators, drivers and labourers, providing livelihoods for as many as 70 families.
The business requires substantial investment. Gill said his operation cost about 45 million rupees ($484,340) to set up and can generate annual turnover of 70 million to 80 million rupees.
The collected straw eventually reaches an 18-megawatt biomass power plant operated by SAEL Industries Ltd, where agricultural waste is used to generate electricity.
SAEL, the country's largest procurer of agricultural residue, is buying 2 million tonnes this year, a fraction of the roughly 750 million tonnes of agricultural waste generated in India each year.
A minimum support price for paddy straw and standardised procurement contracts could help expand the industry and meet the government's target of utilising 10 million tonnes of straw per year, iFOREST's Singh said.
That, she said, could further reduce farm fires, although a much larger expansion would be needed before the impact becomes visible in Delhi's air. 

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: 米司法省、エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ復帰前に正式捜査せず＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff　Erin Banco　Jonathan Landay　Andrew Goudsw...
items.body:
米司法省、エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ復帰前に正式捜査せず＝関係筋
3:36 配信

2026年11月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff　Erin Banco　Jonathan Landay　Andrew Goudsward

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -  米司法省が、トランプ米大統領が今週、半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン氏の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）復帰を後押しする前に、同氏に対する正式な捜査を実施していなかったことが分かった。事情に詳しい３人が明らかにした。

司法省はエヌビディアの顧客企業に対する捜査を進めていたものの、フアン氏本人への正式捜査には着手していなかった。 同氏には中国情報機関とつながりのある女性との不倫疑惑が浮上していた。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた関係者によると、ブランチ米司法長官は、エヌビディアの顧客であるスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターとメガスピード・インターナショナルに対する司法省の捜査を基に、フアン氏が法律に違反した証拠はないと判断した。両社には先端半導体を中国に密輸した疑いがある。

この判断は捜査の進展に伴って変わる可能性がある。ただ、関係者のうち２人によると、ブランチ氏が週末にトランプ氏とバンス副大統領に対し、フアン氏が国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらす証拠は持っていないと伝える決断を下す上で、決定的な役割を果たした。

フアン氏の復帰には、共和、民主両党の議員から反発が出ている。トランプ氏の介入に先立ち、同社やフアン氏の関与をさらに調べる取り組みがなかったことは、議会で追加調査を求める動きを強めそうだ。フアン氏は来週、議会で証言する予定。

関係者２人によると、エヌビディアの顧客企業に対する司法省の捜査では、フアン氏が中国の工作員として活動したり、機微な半導体技術や情報を承知の上で中国に移転したりした証拠は見つからなかった。エヌビディアは捜査対象ではなく、書類やその他のデータの提供、聴取への対応などで協力し、こうした結論につながったという。

フアン氏本人に対する防諜捜査も行われなかった。事情を知る別の関係者２人によると、米情報機関は、メガスピードの元幹部でフアン氏の不倫相手とされるアリス・フアン氏に関する情報を収集してきた。同氏には中国情報機関に協力していた疑いがある。ただ、米国はエヌビディアのＣＥＯに対する捜査を正当化する具体的な情報を持っていなかったという。

防諜捜査は刑事捜査とは別に行われ、起訴に向けた立件ではなく、国家安全保障上の脅威を監視し、無力化することを目的とする。

事情に詳しい関係者２人によると、司法省当局者はエヌビディアとフアン氏に不正行為はなかったと結論付け、同氏が国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらすとは疑っていなかった。

トランプ氏が２３日のＣＮＢＣのインタビューで説明したところによると、同氏とバンス氏がこの結論をエヌビディアの取締役会に伝え、取締役会はフアン氏の復帰を決めた。

＜「良き企業市民」＞

フアン氏は、アリス・フアン氏と少なくとも２人の従業員との不倫疑惑を受け、１１月１２日にエヌビディアのＣＥＯを辞任した。フアン氏は複数の不倫を認めたが、アリス・フアン氏との関係については明確に認めていない。ロイターはアリス・フアン氏と連絡が取れず、中国情報機関とのつながりも確認できていない。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、ルビオ国務長官は５月、この不倫関係についてトランプ氏に説明した。同紙はまた、アリス・フアン氏が不倫関係にあった時期に、１年以上にわたり中国情報機関の高官と連絡を取っていたと報じた。

ブランチ氏はフアン氏の辞任後、同氏がスパイと不倫関係にあったとの報道についてＦＢＩが「調べている」と述べたが、結論には至っていないとしていた。

ブランチ氏は２４日の記者会見で、トランプ政権がどのようにしてフアン氏は米国の国家安全保障上の脅威ではないと判断したのかという質問に、繰り返し回答を控えた。

同氏は、エヌビディアが不正行為に関与した証拠は見つかっていないとした上で、「エヌビディアは良き企業市民ではないという理由は何もない」と語った。

司法省はフアン氏の私生活上の行動とは別に、エヌビディアの事業上の取引について、反トラスト法（独占禁止法）に基づく審査も進めている。

＜スパイ活動への注意喚起＞

専門家は、連邦当局者が通常の防諜手続きを省略したと指摘した。

元中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）職員で、国家安全保障当局の元職員らでつくる団体「ザ・ステディー・ステート」を率いるスティーブ・キャッシュ氏は「国家安全保障に関する疑惑について、司法省が正式に捜査したとの報道はない。驚くことではないにせよ、憂慮すべきことだ」と述べた。

事情を知る法執行当局者によると、ＦＢＩはエヌビディア経営陣に対し、中国のスパイ活動の手口について少なくとも２回、被害防止のための説明を行った。

これらの説明が行われたことは、これまで報じられていなかった。米国の大手テクノロジー企業に日常的に行われる通常の安全対策の一環だったのか、アリス・フアン氏がもたらす脅威に特に焦点を当てたものだったのかは不明。フアン氏本人が説明を受けたかどうかも明らかではない。

法執行機関の元高官２人はロイターに対し、連邦当局者が米企業にスパイ活動のリスクについて幅広く警告することは珍しくないと述べた。

ＣＩＡの元秘密工作員、ケビン・キャロル氏によると、こうした説明での警告が無視された場合、刑事捜査につながることもあるが、主な目的は国家安全保障を守ることにある。

items.body:

Zevia, Bunge Global, and Coca-Cola Consolidated shares skyrocket, what you need to know 3 min read

BG

What happened?
A number of stocks rose in the afternoon session after third-quarter 2026 U.S. economic growth accelerated, October 2026 personal income rose and weekly unemployment claims declined.
The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) reported in its second estimate that real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 4.3% in the third quarter of 2026, up from 2.2% in the second quarter of 2026.
In a separate release, the BEA reported that personal income increased $201.8 billion, or 0.7% at a monthly rate, in October 2026, while disposable personal income rose $200.5 billion, or 0.8%. Personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $63.8 billion, or 0.3%, reflecting increases of $11.8 billion in spending on goods and $52.1 billion in spending on services.
The U.S. Department of Labor reported that seasonally adjusted initial unemployment claims fell by 13,000 to 189,000 in the week ending November 21, 2026, from the previous week's revised level of 202,000. The release also showed that the 4-week moving average decreased by 1,500 to 196,000.
Stronger economic growth, rising income and low unemployment claims can support household budgets and demand for everyday goods. Share prices of consumer staples companies often rise when investors expect steady consumer spending.
The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.
Among others, the following stocks were impacted:
Ingredients, flavors & fragrances company Bunge Global jumped 5.8%. Is now the time to buy Bunge Global? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free.
Beverages, alcohol, and tobacco company Coca-Cola Consolidated jumped 5.2%.
Zooming in on Bunge Global
Bunge Global’s shares are not very volatile and have only had 4 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful, although it might not be something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.
The biggest move we wrote about over the last year was 3 months ago when the stock dropped 3.3% on the news that national cattle shortages and volatile livestock prices squeezed operating margins and prompted outlook cuts across the food production industry. The historic U.S. cattle shortage, which has pushed herd sizes to a 75-year low following years of severe Western drought, has drastically elevated procurement costs for meatpackers, according to Reuters.
This persistent imbalance was highlighted when industry leader Tyson Foods cut its fiscal 2026 adjusted operating income outlook to a range of $2.1 billion to $2.3 billion, down $100 million from its previous forecast, due to worsening beef-segment losses. Tyson projected its full-year adjusted operating loss for the beef business will widen to between $500 million and $650 million, up from its prior estimate of a $350 million to $500 million loss, the company said in its latest financial disclosures. To mitigate these supply-chain headwinds and restructure its beef network, Tyson announced it is closing processing facilities in Joslin, Illinois, and Eagle Mountain, Utah, while pursuing a sale of its Pasco, Washington plant, according to the Wall Street Journal.
These closures follow the shutdown of a massive plant in Lexington, Nebraska earlier this year, collectively resulting in thousands of sector lay-offs. Despite plans by the Trump administration to lift a ban on Mexican cattle imports, chief operating officer Wes Morris noted on an earnings call that it will take up to a year for the industry to benefit, as imported feeder cattle must spend time grazing and fattening before slaughter.
Bunge Global is down 3.7% since the beginning of the year, and at $89.26 per share, it is trading 32.1% below its 52-week high of $131.41 from June 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of Bunge Global’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $986.49.

Every AI server needs specialized infrastructure the chip companies don’t make. High-speed cables. Power connectors. Thermal sensors. This 90-year-old company built a monopoly on it. The AI boom just started. This stock is still flying under the radar.

items.title: Ajay Devgn moves court against FDA notice over Vimal cardamom ads
items.summary: India restricts advertising for liquor and tobacco but officials have for years also frowned upon the use of indirect means, called surrogate advertising ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / Ajay Devgn moves court against FDA notice over Vimal cardamom ads

Ajay Devgn moves court against FDA notice over Vimal cardamom ads India restricts advertising for liquor and tobacco but officials have for years also frowned upon the use of indirect means, called surrogate advertising

Devgn in his filing argues cardamom has not been prohibited in the state and "there is no bar in endorsing a product which is not prohibited"

Reuters NEW DELHI 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 26 2026 | 8:04 AM IST

Listen to This Article

An advertisement for cardamom is at the centre of a legal spat between a Bollywood actor and India's most prominent food commissioner, with a court ruling set to shape how far companies can go in indirectly advertising brands whose promotion is restricted.
India restricts advertising for liquor and tobacco but officials have for years also frowned upon the use of indirect means, called surrogate advertising, by companies in such sectors promoting their brands in the guise of sodas, water or glassware.
While companies say these are genuine businesses in their own right whose advertising cannot be curbed, health officials say the advertisements are aimed at generating recall of the parent brand whose publicity is restricted. Since 2024, India has been trying to finalise stringent guidelines to prohibit such advertisements outright.
  In the case involving Bollywood stars, actor Ajay Devgn has sued the food authority of Maharashtra state, arguing he has been wrongly told to stop appearing in advertisements for Vimal cardamom packs, according to a non-public court filing dated October 15 reviewed by Reuters.
The state, whose food safety commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has become a national sensation for his aggressive stance on public health, asked Bollywood stars Devgn, Shah Rukh Khan and Tiger Shroff in August to stop appearing in advertisements promoting Vimal cardamom, arguing the brand is mostly known for its betel nut mix, or pan masala, which is banned in the state.
Also Read

The spat in the High Court in Mumbai could set a precedent, New Delhi-based lawyer Anuj Tiwari said. "The case will test both the fairness of the department's process before it imposes restrictions ... and the parameters for deciding what counts as indirect advertising," he said.
COURT SPAT ON CARDAMOM AD In the advertisement available on Vimal Cardamom's YouTube page and posted two years ago, the Bollywood stars are seen celebrating, throwing saffron at each other after Devgn consumes the product. The Hindi-language advertisement has 107 million views, while clips dubbed in other Indian languages have garnered millions more.
"Ajay, Shahrukh, and Tiger played saffron Holi like crazy and drenched the entire community in saffron!" says the advertisement's description, referring to the Hindu festival of colour.
Devgn in his filing argues cardamom has not been prohibited in the state and "there is no bar in endorsing a product which is not prohibited".
Devgn did not respond to Reuters queries. Mundhe told Reuters the state believes the advertisements are against public health interests, and the state is separately reviewing responses submitted by Khan and Shroff, although Reuters could not ascertain details of their submissions.
Dushyant Mahant, a lawyer for PB Agro, which holds the licence to make Vimal cardamom and pan masala, told Reuters the allegations were futile as the company does not promote Vimal in Maharashtra and only advertises the product via nationally televised broadcasts that cannot be restricted geographically.
Industry estimates show India's pan masala market was worth around $5 billion last year. Health experts say the product is a leading cause of oral fibrosis that often progresses to oral cancer.
While Maharashtra bans it, Vimal's tobacco-free pan masala sachets in other states cost around ₹5 (5.4 US cents). But they are often consumed with chewing tobacco, sold at kiosks as "twin packs" - a pan masala sachet alongside a tiny pouch of unbranded tobacco.
An adverse ruling in Devgn's case could affect Bollywood stars as endorsements can amount to up to 30% of an actor's earnings, and promoting tobacco-linked products is more lucrative than other advertisements, said Suresh Mathew, a Mumbai-based screenwriter.
"Most actors know if a product is a surrogate for another product," he added. "There are cases where certain actors have refused to lend their name to a product that they feel is harmful." 

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: New images reveal crater on asteroid struck by DART spacecraft
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Nov 25 : Dimorphos, the small asteroid struck by NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022 in the first test of a planetary defense system, was left with one side flattened with a stadium-sized crater and is tumbling in space, as shown by images taken by the European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft released on Wednesday.

New images reveal crater on asteroid struck by DART spacecraft

The asteroid Dimorphos, in orbit around the asteroid Didymos, with a crater caused by the 2022 impact by the DART spacecraft visible, as seen by a camera aboard the European Space Agency's Hera robotic spacecraft from a distance of 29 km, in this image taken on November 7, 2026. FAST

Nov 25 : Dimorphos, the small asteroid struck by NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022 in the first test of a planetary defense system, was left with one side flattened with a stadium-sized crater and is tumbling in space, as shown by images taken by the European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft released on Wednesday.
DART was sent on a proof-of-principle mission for using a spacecraft to change a celestial object's trajectory. Dimorphos, an oblong-shaped rocky object about 495 feet (151 meters) wide, orbits its companion asteroid Didymos, with a diameter of 2,395 feet (730 meters), and the pair is currently about 120 million miles (193.5 million km) from Earth.
They are defined as near-Earth asteroids, though neither object imperils Earth. Previous data showed how DART succeeded in changing the path of Dimorphos — demonstrating that a spacecraft could alter the trajectory of an object headed toward a collision with Earth. Hera is now getting a close-up look at how DART physically changed Dimorphos.
"The side impacted is now completely covered by a crater, with the visual impression that a piece of the asteroid was cut off by the impact. We do not see evidence for major changes on the site opposite to the DART impact. The combination of those two observations is surprising," Michael Kueppers, ESA's Hera mission scientist, told Reuters.

The big crater covers nearly the whole front side of Dimorphos as it continues its orbit of Didymos. 
"Dimorphos is now tumbling in a chaotic way. There are hundreds of boulders floating around in the system," Kueppers said.
Hera, about the size of a small car, is presently observing Didymos and Dimorphos from a distance of about 15 to 19 miles (25 to 30 km). Hera next month is slated to approach within 8 miles (13 km) of the pair, obtaining increasingly higher-resolution images. 
In January, Hera is due to deploy two shoebox-sized miniature satellites, called CubeSats, that will approach even closer for further study, including investigating the interior structure of the two asteroids.
Hera's mission manager unveiled the new images at a dinosaur hall in the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin as a reminder of the danger of asteroid impacts like the one 66 million years ago that caused a mass extinction on Earth and doomed the dinosaurs.
The DART, short for Double Asteroid Redirection Test, spacecraft collided with Dimorphos on September 26, 2022, at about 14,000 miles per hour (22,530 kph).
"We knew that the DART mission impacted Dimorphos successfully and that it changed its orbit. But we did not know what happened to Dimorphos itself. The investigation of what the impact did to Dimorphos and the characterization of it in general is needed to be able to apply the kinetic impactor technique to another asteroid, should we find one on a collision course with Earth," Kueppers said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Marvell Technology Stocks Fall 8.47% as Data Center Exposure Bites
items.summary: MRVL shares fell 8.47% to $120.43 at 9:40 a.m. ET on November 25 in regular-session trading, as chipmakers led the market lower on persistent selling in AI-linked names and new U.S. tariff proposals.
items.body:
News
/ GuruFocus
/ Marvell Technology Stocks Fall 8.47% as Data Center Exposure Bites

Marvell Technology Stocks Fall 8.47% as Data Center Exposure Bites Less than 1 min read

MRVL
Marvell Technology MRVL shares fell 8.47% to $120.43 at 9:40 a.m. ET on November 25 in regular-session trading, as chipmakers led the market lower on persistent selling in AI-linked names and new U.S. tariff proposals. Marvell was down 6.6% before the open and fell further once regular trading began.
The data infrastructure chipmaker is heavily tied to the AI build-out. Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue rose 37% to $2.74 billion, and data center revenue grew 46% to $2.17 billion, about 79% of total sales. Marvell guided third-quarter revenue to $3.15 billion, plus or minus 5%, with non-GAAP EPS of $1.10.

That guide implies about 15% sequential growth, but heavy data center concentration means any pause in hyperscaler spending lands directly on Marvell's top line. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 85/100: strong momentum and a solid balance sheet, held back by an average profitability rank. GuruFocus puts GF Value at $129.91, a 7.3% discount, and calls the shares fairly valued, so the drop has not created a deep margin of safety. The next test is the third-quarter report: whether Marvell hits the $3.15 billion guide and what it signals for custom AI chips in fiscal 2028.

WASHINGTON, Nov 25 : The Federal Communications Commission is authorizing Elon Musk's SpaceX to deploy a constellation of 1 million satellites for data centers in space, the agency said on Wednesday.
SpaceX earlier this year sought permission to deploy up to 1 million orbital compute modules to process massive amounts of data to be used on Earth. The FCC said it was approving the SpaceX “Starmind” constellation to help meet rapidly growing demand for AI computing.
Under the license, SpaceX must begin deployment no later than November 2033, deploy 10 per cent of the maximum number — or 100,000 — no later than November 2035 and deploy 50 per cent by November 2038, the FCC said.
Approving the application will permit SpaceX "to pioneer emergent technology that advances American leadership in space and artificial intelligence," the FCC added.

Data centers are the physical backbone of artificial intelligence, requiring massive amounts of power.
"By directly harnessing near-constant solar power with little operating or maintenance costs, these satellites will achieve transformative cost and energy efficiency while significantly reducing the environmental impact associated with terrestrial data centers," SpaceX told the FCC.
It was unclear whether SpaceX would put 1 million satellites in space, where only 17,000 satellites exist currently. Satellite operators sometimes request approval for higher numbers of satellites than they intend to deploy to buy design flexibility.
SpaceX sought approval for 42,000 Starlink satellites before it began deployment of that system. The growing network currently has just over 11,000 satellites in space.
SpaceX's request bets heavily on reduced costs of Starship, the company's next-generation reusable rocket under development, to help deploy satellites.
Amazon's rival satellite unit Leo and others have criticized the plan, suggesting SpaceX was unlikely to deploy all the satellites and that it could take centuries to do so. FCC Chair Brendan Carr rejected that criticism in March.
"Amazon should focus on getting Amazon's house in order with their own launches and their own satellite constellation, rather than worrying about other people that are actually out there launching satellites at the pace and cadence that SpaceX is," Carr said.
The FCC said it was also approving SpaceX's requests to back up its optical network by approving additional communications.

Source: Reuters

NEW YORK: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq retreated on Wednesday (Nov 25) amid a tech selloff, but finished well off the day's lows as bargain hunters stepped in ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday.
The Dow finished higher.
The Nasdaq fell more than 4 per cent early in the session as the selloff in AI-related stocks and new US tariff proposals hit sentiment.
"There are all these potential headwinds, but then there's also a certain amount of conditioning of buying on the dip, and that's part of what we're seeing," said Oliver Pursche, senior vice president and adviser for Wealthspire Advisors in Westport, Connecticut.

"The broad selloffs tend to kind of throw the baby out with the bathwater. Investors are taking advantage of some of those discrepancies," he said.
Technology and consumer discretionary fell 1 per cent each and led declines among S&P 500 sectors, while materials and real estate led gainers . Value stocks outperformed growth, with the Russell 1000 value index up 0.4 per cent and the Russell 1000 growth index down 0.8 per cent.
Wall Street has been roiled this month, partly because of worries about AI leader Nvidia. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month, but the company's board reinstated him on Monday. The Nasdaq Composite is down 7.3 per cent for the month.
"This has broadly been a more sentiment-driven type of selloff," said Charlie Ripley, senior investment strategist at Allianz Investment Management.
At the same time, for some companies from a price-to-earnings perspective, "things are starting to look more attractive", he said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 164.25 points, or 0.33 per cent, to 50,182.95, the S&P 500 lost 18.31 points, or 0.25 per cent, to 7,182.78 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 147.73 points, or 0.62 per cent, to 23,585.80.
The market will be closed on Thursday and will close early on Friday.

Also read:

Trump announces new tariffs on 14 trading partners including China and Singapore

Jensen Huang’s stunning return as Nvidia CEO: A timeline of events

AI WORRIES LINGER Nvidia shares fell 3.9 per cent and an index of semiconductors was off 0.7 per cent, while shares of Amazon fell 3.1 per cent. On the plus side, PC maker HP gained 11.5 per cent after it reported fourth-quarter revenue and profit above analysts' estimates.
Fears of increased regulatory scrutiny of the AI sector following the Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections have added to worries about AI stocks . Early in the day, the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20 per cent from its record closing high, flirting with bear-market territory.
New tariffs could cloud the outlook for investors grappling with the prospect of interest rates staying higher for longer, as inflation has accelerated and oil prices have risen steadily due to the Iran war.
The US proposed tariffs on goods from 14 trading partners to combat what it calls structural excess industrial capacity, reviving global trade tensions
In addition, investors digested data showing the US economy grew much faster than initially estimated in the third quarter, while inflation increased further in October, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates next month and again in early 2027.
"Tariffs are somewhat responsible for inflation ... so that's actually being counterproductive to what the Fed is trying to do," said Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities in New York.
Volume was lower than average for part of the session. Trading on US exchanges ended at about 22 billion shares.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [２５日 ロイター] - 米当局者が議会スタッフに対し、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫...
items.body:
エヌビディアＣＥＯ不倫相手に中国スパイ指示の証拠なし、米当局が議会に説明＝米紙
1:39 配信

2024年6月2日撮影。台湾・台北で撮影。エヌビディアのフアンCEOとアリス・フアン氏。REUTERS/Ann Wang/File Photo（ロイター） [２５日 ロイター] - 米当局者が議会スタッフに対し、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫関係にあったアリス・フアン氏が、中国の情報機関からスパイ活動を指示された証拠は見つからなかったと説明していたことが分かった。

米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２５日、事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）、連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）、国家情報長官室（ＯＤＮＩ）、国家安全保障局（ＮＳＡ）の当局者が、上下両院の情報委員会と議会指導部のスタッフに説明した。説明は、トランプ米大統領が今週初め、ジェンスン・フアン氏が国家安全保障上の脅威ではないとエヌビディアに保証し、同氏の復職に道を開いた後に行われた。

問題の発端となったのは、アリス・フアン氏と中国情報機関とのつながりを巡る疑惑や、アリス氏とフアンＣＥＯの関係が、エヌビディア製半導体の中国への横流し疑惑に影響したかどうかという懸念だった。

ＷＳＪによると、当局者は、アリス・フアン氏が不倫関係にあった期間中、中国の情報機関と接触していたと説明した。ただ、重要な情報を提供した形跡は見つからなかったという。現時点の証拠は、両氏が恋愛関係にあった可能性を示唆しているものの、中国による組織的な工作だったことは示していない。ただし、新たな情報によって、この評価が変わる可能性があるという。

エヌビディアと各機関は、ロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。ロイターは報道を独自に確認できていない。

1:16 配信

2026年11月20日、米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Shashwat Chauhan

[２５日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下げが止まらない。２５日の株式市場では、ＡＩインフラ整備費用の急増に見合う収益が得られるかを投資家が見極める中、半導体メーカーやサーバーメーカー、データセンター運営会社が軒並み大幅下落した。

多額の借り入れに頼ることも多い巨額のインフラ投資と、その収益の不確実性への懸念が強まる中、投資家はＡＩ関連企業に高いハードルを課している。業績が期待を下回れば売りを浴びせる一方、予想を上回る業績や見通しの引き上げにも反応は鈍い。

クロスチェック・マネジメントの最高投資責任者、トッド・シェーンバーガー氏は「各社は支出額で互いを上回ろうとしているように見えるが、それに見合う価値があることを示さなければならない。その点について、株式市場は確信が持てないようだ」と述べた。

ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック１００指数は４．３％下落。このまま取引を終えれば、構成銘柄の時価総額は１日で１兆５０００億ドル超失われる見通しだ。一時、１０月６日に付けた終値の過去最高値からの下落率が２０％に達し、この水準で引ければ弱気相場入りが確認される。

サーバーメーカーのデル・テクノロジーズは２５日、５．７％下落した。通期の売上高と利益の見通しについて今年３度目の上方修正を行い、２５０億ドルの追加自社株買いを承認したものの、売られた。

競合するＡＩサーバーメーカーのＨＰＥは、通期売上高見通しを引き上げたにもかかわらず、２４日に１６．３％急落。２５日も３．２％下落した。同業のスーパー・マイクロは５．４％安となった。

ＡＩ半導体企業アンバレラは２０．９％急落した。第４・四半期の売上高見通しがアナリスト予想を下回った。

「クロード」を開発するアンソロピックは８．２％下落。記録的なナスダック上場からわずか数日で、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の８３ドルを大きく下回って取引されている。

市場全体では、トランプ政権が１４の貿易相手国・地域からの輸入品に新たな関税を課す案を示したことや、１０月の米インフレ率が一段と上昇したことを示す統計も投資家心理の重しとなり、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数は約３％下落した。

半導体株にも売り圧力がかかった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．１％下落し、７カ月超ぶりの安値を付けた。６月の過去最高値からの下落率は４３％を超えている。

混乱の中心にあるエヌビディアは８．４％安。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の復帰をきっかけとした上昇は早々に勢いを失い、２４日の６％安に続く下落となった。

エヌビディアは、巨大クラウド事業者「ハイパースケーラー」からＡＩ向けクラウド事業者「ネオクラウド」まで幅広い顧客に半導体を供給しており、ＡＩ関連投資の重要な指標であり続けている。

ＡＩ分野のハイパースケーラー株も総じて下落。オラクル、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コム、メタ・プラットフォームズ、マイクロソフトは２．９─５．５％下落した。

＜ＡＩ投資が債務負担を増大＞

エヌビディアが出資するネオクラウド企業のコアウィーブとネビウス・グループは、それぞれ１０％超下落。アイレン、アプライド・デジタル、コア・サイエンティフィックは６．９─１０．８％下落した。

ＡＩに特化した計算能力を貸し出すネオクラウド事業者は、急速な事業拡大を支える借り入れへの懸念から、１０月以降、売り圧力にさらされている。

今月の中間選挙で民主党が勝利したことも、こうした懸念を強めた。投資家は、ＡＩ規制の強化や建設の障壁増大によってデータセンターの整備が減速する可能性を見極めている。

トレードウェブのデータによると、コアウィーブの２０３１年償還債は、額面１ドル当たりの価格が０．０２ドル近く下落して過去最低水準に迫り、利回りは１８％近くに上昇した。

ハイテク企業の債務不履行に備える保証コストも急上昇。オラクル、アルファベット、スペースＸ、コアウィーブの５年物クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）のスプレッドは過去最高水準に達した。

Anthropic's slide tests Wall Street's lofty bets on future AI profits

Anthropic, PBC (ANT) advertisements are displayed in Times Square on the day Anthropic, PBC (ANT) holds their initial public offering (IPO) at the NASDAQ MarketSite in New York City, US, November 19, 2026. REUTERS/Mike Segar

FAST

Nov 25 : Anthropic's slide below its initial public offering price has sharpened investor scrutiny of lofty technology valuations, as markets increasingly question whether even the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom can generate enough profit to justify their price tags.
Shares of the Claude developer were trading around $80.50, well below their $83 offer price and nearly 30 per cent below their opening price on November 19.
The swift reversal highlights growing unease over how much investors are willing to pay for future growth, even as earnings prospects improve for many companies benefiting from artificial intelligence.
Of the 86 Nasdaq-100 companies with positive earnings multiples and available earnings revision data, 60 saw their forward 12-month earnings forecasts rise over the past three months, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data showed. Yet, shares in 37 of those companies declined over the same period.

Nvidia shares have fallen about 25 per cent over the past three months despite a nearly 20 per cent increase in its earnings forecasts, partly driven by the volatile swings around CEO Jensen Huang's abrupt exit and reinstatement, while Marvell Technology and Lumentum have each lost more than 40 per cent of their market value even as earnings estimates rose 15 per cent and 20 per cent, respectively.
HIGH EXPECTATIONS
Despite the selloff, substantial valuation premiums persist.
The 25 most richly valued companies in the Nasdaq-100 — many with exposure to AI, autonomous driving and other emerging technologies — traded at a median of 38 times projected earnings for the next 12 months, compared with 18 times for the remaining companies with positive earnings multiples, Reuters calculations showed.
Anthropic illustrates how much future growth is already embedded in technology share prices.
Morningstar's fair value estimate of $92 per share, just 12 per cent above Anthropic's latest closing price, assumes its annual revenue will increase nearly sevenfold over the next five years. Morningstar's estimates range from $25 to $188 per share under different scenarios, underscoring how sensitive Anthropic's valuation is to assumptions about future growth and profitability.
The reassessment of valuations has been uneven across the tech sector.
Forward price-to-earnings multiples for cybersecurity firms Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks rose the most over the past three months, climbing 11.5 per cent and 10.8 per cent, respectively. Multiples for Sandisk, Nvidia, Intuit Inc and Analog Devices contracted the most, falling between 15 per cent and 26 per cent, LSEG data showed.
"Investors pay up for earnings they believe will last and discount those they think will fade," said Christopher Gannatti, global head of research at asset manager WisdomTree.
Gannatti contrasted Palantir's high valuation with memory-chip maker Micron's much lower multiple, arguing that high memory prices could spur additional supply and eventually depress prices and profits.
Palantir trades at 65 times forward earnings, compared with just 3.5 times for Micron, LSEG data showed.
THE COST OF GROWTH
The cost of delivering the growth implied by these valuations is another threat to future profitability.
CoreWeave reported a 168 per cent rise in third-quarter revenue to $3.66 billion and a contracted revenue backlog of $132.5 billion. Yet the AI computing provider recorded a net loss of $709 million and expects capital spending of $37 billion to $39 billion this year.
"Technological breakthroughs don't automatically translate into attractive returns on capital," said Troy Hooper, co-head of equity capital markets for the Americas at Mergermarket. "A year ago, investors were paying a much bigger premium for the promise of AI. Today, they're getting more tangible evidence of that promise and are seeking stronger profits."
Growing competition could push down AI prices for customers, to the detriment of the companies investing heavily in the technology, Hooper said.
Willis Tsai, head of global equities at Nuveen, said rising depreciation charges on AI chips and servers could erode cloud companies' profit margins even as demand for computing capacity grows.

(Reporting By Patturaja Murugaboopathy, Editing by Vidya Ranganathan and Nia Williams)

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した１０月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換...
items.body:
米新築住宅販売、10月は14.2％増の70.1万戸　10カ月ぶり高水準
1:01 配信

7月14日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した１０月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比１４．２％増の７０万１０００戸と、２０２５年１２月以来、１０カ月ぶりの高水準となった。建設業者が購入者を呼び込むために価格を引き下げたことで急増したものの、住宅ローン金利の上昇は依然として住宅市場全体の活動を抑える要因となっている。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は６５万戸だった。前年同月比では７．５％増加した。   

９月分は６１万４０００戸と、当初発表の６７万６０００戸から下方改定された。

３０年固定住宅ローン金利は、米国とイスラエルが２月末にイランを攻撃して以降、約１３０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇した。住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、先週は平均７．２８％だった。 

１０月の販売急増にもかかわらず、新築住宅の在庫は依然として高水準にあり、建設業者が新たな一戸建て住宅プロジェクトに着工する能力を今後も妨げる可能性が高い。

１０月の新築住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比３．２％下落の３９万１３００ドル。１０月に販売された住宅の大半は３９万９９９９ドル以下の価格帯だった。

新築住宅在庫は４７万戸と、前月の４７万７０００戸から減少した。

１０月の販売ペースに基づく在庫の消化期間は８．０カ月と、２０２５年１２月以来の低水準となった。前月は９．３カ月だった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュッセル／チューリヒ　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米政権が通商法３０１条に基づく新たな関税措置を提案したこと...
items.body:
ＥＵとスイス、米関税上限15％順守に期待　新措置提案受け
0:55 配信

１１月２５日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [ブリュッセル／チューリヒ　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米政権が通商法３０１条に基づく新たな関税措置を提案したことを受け、欧州連合（ＥＵ）とスイスは、米国が導入するいかなる措置もこれまでに合意された関税率上限１５％と整合するものになるとの認識を示した。

ＥＵの執行機関である欧州委員会の報道官は、昨年の米ＥＵの関税合意を定めた共同声明で合意された関税率上限１５％に言及した上で、「共同声明に基づき、１５％の包括的な関税上限はＥＵ製品に適用される。今回の調査に基づくいかなる措置も、既存の関税と合わせた場合を含め、この上限を完全に順守すると期待している」と述べた。

また、世界的な過剰生産能力の問題を巡り米欧が共同で行動できていないことに遺憾の意を示し、欧州が構造的な過剰生産能力の発生源になっているとの見方を強く否定した。

スイス経済省も、昨年合意されたスイス製品に対する米関税の上限を１５％とする取り決めと整合するものになるとの認識を示し、合意順守を期待するとした。

スイスの経済団体エコノミースイスも政府と足並みをそろえ、過剰生産能力を巡る米国の主張を否定した上で、関税上限１５％の合意が尊重されるよう要請。米国に対する貿易黒字は主に医薬品と金（ゴールド）の輸出によるもので、産業の過剰生産能力とは無関係との認識を示し、米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）が問題視している鉄鋼、アルミニウム、自動車、電池、太陽光パネル、セメント、船舶、半導体といった分野について「スイスには当てはまらない」とした。

ＥＣＢ、最低準備率引き上げ協議　12月か27年初めにも決定へ＝関係筋

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 英イングランド銀行（中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）のベイリー総裁は２５日、ここ数週間のエネルギー...
items.body:
英インフレピークは予測下回る可能性、エネ価格安定なら＝中銀総裁
0:30 配信

英イングランド銀行のベイリー総裁。11月5日、ロンドンの英中銀本部で撮影。Alishia Abodunde/Pool via REUTERS（ロイター） [ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 英イングランド銀行（中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）のベイリー総裁は２５日、ここ数週間のエネルギー価格の下落を受けて、国際エネルギー価格が足元の水準で安定すれば、英国のインフレ率は今月初めに公表された予測よりも低い水準で推移する可能性があるとの見方を示した。 

英中銀は１１月５日に公表した基本予測で、国内インフレ率は来年半ばに目標の２倍を超える５％前後に達するとの見通しを示していたが、それ以降、原油・ガス価格は下落している。今月に入り、北海ブレント原油先物は約２０％、英国の天然ガス先物は１５％下落した。ただ、２月末の中東での戦争勃発前の水準をなお大幅に上回っている。  

ベイリー氏は議会財務委員会で「現在の価格水準が維持されれば、インフレ率のピークは機械的に低くなるだろう」と述べた。同氏は、英経済は最近、一段と底堅さを示しており、労働市場の緩和傾向も止まっているとし、英中銀はこれらをインフレ予想に織り込む必要があるとの考えを表明。その上で、追加利上げの公算が大きいとの見解を改めて示した。

また、ロンバルデリ副総裁は財務委員会で、英中銀は来年、食品価格のインフレ率が５％前後に上昇すると予想していると述べた。最近の賃金データについてはまちまちだと指摘し、直近のインフレデータを踏まえ、基調的なディスインフレ傾向が依然として順調に進んでいるかどうかについて確信が持てなくなっていると述べた。

さらに、金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は、企業の利益率の圧迫がインフレ抑制に今後も寄与し続けるとは考えていないとし、「最適な対応策は、より大幅に、より早期に利上げすることだ」と述べた。

金利先物市場は、英中銀が８０％の確率で来月に２回目の利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでおり、２７年にさらに２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが２回あると見ている。

items.body:
米ＧＤＰ、第3四半期改定値4.3％増　ＡＩ主導で3年ぶり高成長
0:11 配信

2025年11月16日、米ニューヨークのホリデーマーケットで撮影。REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）改定値は年率換算で前期比４．３％増だった。速報値の３．４％増から上方修正され、３年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は、３．５％増への上方修正だった。第２・四半期は２．２％増だった。

今回の上方修正は、主に人工知能（ＡＩ）に関連する個人消費と設備投資の伸び率が引き上げられたことを反映した。経済全体の３分の２超を占める個人消費の伸びは４．２％増と、速報値の３．８％増から上方修正された。

消費は主に高所得世帯が主導している。これらの世帯の資産は、人工知能（ＡＩ）主導の売り浴びせが始まる前の株式市場によって押し上げられていた。歴史的な低水準の一時解雇（レイオフ）と緩やかな雇用増加も、他の世帯が消費を維持する一助となっているが、賃金の伸びは時にインフレに追いついていない。世帯は貯蓄を減らし、蓄えを取り崩してもいる。

設備投資は２１．８％増と、前月推計された２０．９％増から上方修正された。設備投資は３四半期連続で２桁の伸びを記録しているものの、エコノミストらは、投資家がＡＩの企業価値を精査するにつれて、この傾向が鈍化する可能性があると警告している。

政府支出、貿易、在庫を除く民間国内最終需要は５．８％増と、速報値の４．９％増から上方修正され、２０２１年第２・四半期以来の高い伸びとなった。

第３・四半期の国内生産から生じた企業利益は２０６０億ドル増加。前期は３８４０億ドル増だった。

国内総所得（ＧＤＩ）は４．４％増だった。前期は２．３％増だった。

経済活動を判断する上でより良い指標とされるＧＤＰとＧＤＩの平均は４．４％増だった。前期は２．２％増だった。

items.title: Glencore taps former CEO’s nephew to lead coal unit
items.author: Marina Meireles
items.creator: Marina Meireles
items.summary: Colin Glasenberg has been working at Glencore since 2011, and his uncle, Ivan Glasenberg led the company for 20 years.
items.body:
Glencore taps former CEO’s nephew to lead coal unit 
Colin Glasenberg has been working at Glencore since 2011, and his uncle, Ivan Glasenberg led the company for 20 years.

Marina Meireles
|
November 25, 2026 - 9:43 am

Categories:
Coal
Europe
Top Companies

Ivan Glasenberg, Glencore's former chief executive officer ( Image: Wikipedia )

Glencore (LON: GLEN) has appointed Colin Glasenberg, the nephew of former chief executive officer and the company’s largest shareholder Ivan Glasenberg, to lead its massive coal mining unit. 

Colin Glasenberg, who joined the Swiss commodities giant in 2011 and has served as its industrial lead for oil since 2020, succeeds Earl Melamed, who is retiring after three decades with the company.  

Mark Power, currently an asset manager in the energy business, is set to replace Glasenberg as head of oil assets, Bloomberg reported.  

Glencore produces about 130 million tonnes of coal annually, generating $4.85 billion of adjusted core earnings in 2025. It is the top global coal shipper and is benefitting from coal demand due to the energy and oil crisis caused by geopolitical conflicts, like the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and the Russia-Ukraine war. 

Coal demand to rise 1.2% as Hormuz closure drives gas prices: IEA

Ivan Glasenberg was Glencore’s CEO from until his retirement in 2021. Today he holds 10.42% of Glencore’s shares valued at about $8.33 million. 

Glencore didn’t provide comments on Glasenberg’s appointment.  

Shares in Glencore were down 2% to £432.25 apiece by market close on Wednesday in London, valuing the company at £50.6 billion ($66.2 billion). 

(With files from Bloomberg and Reuters)

The US Treasury Department is working with the Federal Bureau of Investigation, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and third-party forensic examiners to determine the scope and impact, according to the official.

items.summary: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省センサス局が２５日発表した１０月の耐久財受注は、民間設備投資の先行指標と...
items.body:
米10月コア資本財受注1.2％増、ＡＩ投資過熱警戒で勢い鈍化も
11/25 23:36 配信

2025年2月21日、米国イリノイ州メンドータにある工場。 REUTERS/Vincent Alban（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省センサス局が２５日発表した１０月の耐久財受注は、民間設備投資の先行指標とされるコア資本財（非国防資本財から航空機を除く）の受注が前月比１．２％増加した。出荷も堅調に伸び、企業の設備投資が勢いを維持したことを示唆した。ただ、ＡＩ（人工知能）の企業価値を巡る投資家の警戒が強まっており、この勢いが鈍化する可能性もある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想では、コア資本財受注は０．７％増加すると見込まれていた。

９月は０．８％増に上方修正された。

１０月は前年同月比では１１．２％増加した。

国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計の設備投資（機器）の算出に用いられるコア資本財の出荷は、１０月に０．６％増加した。９月は１．３％増だった。

設備投資（機器）はＡＩへの積極的な投資を追い風に、３四半期連続で２桁の伸びを記録している。ただ、ＡＩの資金調達や収益性、規制、データセンター開発への世論の反発を巡る幅広い疑問が浮上してきている。ハイテク企業はこの１年、ＡＩ投資に向けて巨額の資金を借り入れてきた。

耐久財受注全体は１０月に０．２％増加した。９月は２．０％の大幅増だった。１０月は前年同月比では８．３％増加した。１０月は輸送用機器の受注が０．３％減少したことで全体が抑制された。耐久財はトースターから航空機まで３年以上使われるモノを指す。

項目別の受注は、自動車・部品が０．９％増加した。一方、変動の大きい民間航空機は０．３％減少し、自動車・部品の増加分を上回って全体を押し下げた。米航空機大手ボーイングのウェブサイトによると、１０月の航空機受注数は１６５機で９月と同水準だったが、大半は低価格の７３７ＭＡＸ機だった。

items.body:
米新規失業保険申請1.3万件減の18.9万件、予想以上に減少
11/25 23:26 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスにある地元企業のドアに掲げられた求人看板。2025年8月1日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が２５日発表した１１月２１日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１万３０００件減の１８万９０００件となった。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（２０万件）以上に減少し、労働市場の安定を示唆した。

申請件数は７月中旬以降、かなり低い水準で推移している。エコノミストは、労働市場が依然として「低採用・低解雇」の完全雇用の状態にあると見ている。労働市場の安定を受け、インフレ抑制に取り組む連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、１２月に予想される利上げに続いて追加利上げを行う道を開く公算が大きい。 

１１月１４日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は９万５０００件減の１６９万７０００件だった。今回の継続受給件数のデータは、１１月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。    

今回の統計は、２６日の感謝祭の祝日を控え、通常より１日早く公表された。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - 米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が２５日発表した１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指...
items.body:
米10月ＰＣＥ価格指数、前年比＋3.8％に伸び加速　利上げ観測強まる
11/25 23:09 配信

8月26日、米ニューヨークの食料品店で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - 米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が２５日発表した１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．８％上昇し、９月の３．６％上昇から伸びが加速した。これを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２０２７年初めまで利上げを続けるとの観測が強まった。前年比の伸びはエコノミスト予想と一致した。

前月比では０．３％上昇し、９月の０．５％上昇（改定なし）から伸びが鈍化した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．３％上昇だった。

変動の大きい食品・エネルギーを除くコアＰＣＥ価格指数は前年比３．３％上昇し、９月の３．１％上昇から伸びが拡大し、２３年１１月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前月比では３カ月連続で０．３％上昇となった。

個人消費支出は前月比０．３％増加した。９月は当初発表の０．５％増から０．６％増に上方改定された。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「景気需要を冷やすために、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げペースを加速させることがこれまで以上に喫緊の課題となっている」と指摘。「かつては、輸入関税や中東戦争に伴うエネルギー価格が、インフレ上昇の一時的な要因だと考えられていたが、インフレの火に油を注いでいるのは、昔ながらの経済需要の圧力であるとの見方がますます強まっている」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、金融市場は１２月８─９日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでおり、１月にも追加利上げがあるとみている。

FAST

GUANGZHOU, Nov 25 : Nio chief executive William Li said on Wednesday the company could raise its gross profit margin by 10 per centage points over the long run as it deploys artificial intelligence across its business units to boost efficiency. 
• Ahead of the Guangzhou Auto Show, which will kick off on Friday, Nio said at its technology day in the southern city that it has deployed 7,500 AI agents in areas including research and development, manufacturing, logistics and car sales
• Li told reporters that embedding AI into automakers' business operations "will be critical to staying competitive and driving the next wave of transformation"
• The Chinese electric vehicle maker also unveiled the third generation of its World Model, which it said would require 40 per cent fewer driver interventions for its advanced driver-assistance system and less computing power to train the technology

FAST

LONDON, Nov 25 : Britain is advancing plans to open up BBC iPlayer to advertising and rival broadcasters, potentially paving the way for an overhaul of the streaming platform, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.
The proposal would represent a significant expansion of iPlayer's role as a platform for BBC programmes, with one of the people saying the technology upgrade that would be required could cost tens of millions of pounds.
The potential technology investment to allow iPlayer to carry advertising attached to content from rivals including Channel 4 has not been reported previously. It is part of wider efforts among British broadcasters to compete with global streaming services such as Netflix, Disney+ and Amazon Prime Video.
The change is expected to feature in a White Paper on the BBC's charter renewal, due by the end of the year, setting out the government's position on the public broadcaster's funding, governance and remit from 2028, the two people said.

The BBC pointed to comments by Director General Matt Brittin, who in July said one opportunity for Channel 4 would be “in partnership with the BBC, having content on iPlayer, but continuing to be ad-funded".
The BBC's current funding model is based on a licence fee paid by TV-watching households.
The proposal could also potentially enable the BBC to carry advertising around some of its own content, something barred under its current charter, the first person added. The government said last year that one option under consideration was to allow advertising around older BBC iPlayer content.
The investment could be funded by the BBC's commercial arm, with the funds recovered over time through fees charged to third-party content providers, the first person said.
An upgrade to iPlayer would also allow UKTV, the BBC-owned commercial broadcaster that operates advertising-funded channels such as U&Drama and U&Dave, to integrate content into the platform, the two people said.
Other broadcasters, including ITV, could join in time, the second person added, potentially creating a shared platform for a wider range of British television content.
The plan echoes Project Kangaroo, a proposed joint streaming venture between the BBC, ITV and Channel 4 that was blocked by UK regulators in 2009. Since then, streaming services and YouTube have taken a growing share of viewing. 
SHARED PLATFORM FOR BRITISH BROADCASTERS
The British government told Reuters it was aware that Channel 4 and the BBC were open to collaboration and partnership.
"We continue to support and encourage all public service media providers to explore strategic partnerships where they benefit their audiences and the sustainability of the public service media ecosystem as a whole," a Department for Culture, Media and Sport spokesperson said.
"The BBC must be funded by a model that is sustainable and fair. Through the BBC Charter Review, we are looking at a range of options, including how the licence fee could be reformed, but no final decisions have been made."
A BBC spokesperson said: "As we have said before, we believe increased collaboration between all public service broadcasters is vital to ensure the industry thrives in a highly competitive global marketplace."
Channel 4 Chief Executive Priya Dogra told lawmakers this month that the iPlayer idea was "worth exploring" but said that details needed to be worked out, including how advertising would work.
British broadcasters are increasingly distributing their content through rival platforms to reach new audiences. Channel 4 will make some programmes available on Disney+ next year while the BBC is testing CBeebies children's programming content on Netflix.
British media regulator Ofcom said in July that 26 per cent of UK viewers turned to Netflix first when deciding what to watch, compared with 25 per cent for the BBC.
In its March submission to the BBC Charter Review, the BBC proposed exploring the integration of UKTV into iPlayer while keeping it distinct from BBC-branded content and services.

Source: Reuters

FAST

CAIRO: Israel's military killed a senior Hamas security official as well as his wife and two children with an airstrike on their Gaza Strip apartment early on Wednesday (Nov 25), Gaza's Hamas-run interior ministry and medics said.
The airstrike that killed Mohammad Abuelouf, a Hamas colonel who heads the militants' interior security service, and his family was the second Israeli attack to kill a senior Hamas security official in the past 24 hours.
Despite a year-old ceasefire, Israel has continued to carry out attacks that it says target Hamas but have also killed many civilians. The broader ceasefire plan, backed by United States President Donald Trump, has failed to halt the violence or secure Hamas' disarmament.
Medics said the airstrike ripped through Abuelouf's apartment early on Wednesday in the Beach refugee camp in western Gaza City, near the coast. Later in the morning, another Israeli airstrike hit Gaza City's northern Karama neighbourhood, killing one person, medics said.

Asked for comment, Israel's military said it "targeted several military operatives" in Gaza. It said it would issue further comment later.
On Tuesday, after the military killed Naeem Abu Nahel, Hamas' head of internal security, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said there was no escape for Hamas from his country's "long reach".
Hamas' internal security service, which Abu Nahel ran and in which Abuelouf was a senior official, counters Palestinians suspected of collaboration with Israel's secret service and gathers information about its plans.
At least 1,600 Palestinians and five Israeli soldiers have been killed since the ceasefire was struck in October 2025, according to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies.
Israeli troops now control around two-thirds of Gaza, up from more than half at the time of the ceasefire, with Hamas controlling a sliver of territory along Gaza's coast.
Israel's assault on Gaza has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians since 2023, caused a hunger crisis, internally displaced Gaza's entire population and led to assessments of genocide from scholars and United Nations inquiries.
Israel has said its actions were in self-defence after Hamas-led militants killed 1,200 people and took more than 250 hostages in an attack on Israel in October 2023.

FAST

Nov 25 : AI-linked stocks plunged early on Wednesday but staged an afternoon comeback, the latest autumn clash pitting investor concern about rising costs and forbidding debt dynamics against strong buying interest given the steep decline in prices.
AI lab Anthropic traded as low as $73.85 shortly after the open, putting it 11 per cent below its initial offering price last week, before it rallied to close 1 per cent higher at $82.19. Alphabet dropped 4.7 per cent and hit a 52-week low before closing the gap to end down 2.1 per cent. Chip giant Broadcom, one of the leaders of an epic midyear semiconductor rally, dropped 5.8 per cent before ending flat.
The Nasdaq Composite ended down 0.6 per cent after early trading off as much as 4.6 per cent. The Nasdaq-100 had a similar trajectory, closing down 0.6 per cent on the day after briefly flirting with a decline of 20 per cent from last month's high.
Despite the rebound, the declines were the second straight daily drop in tech and reflected the unwind of earlier optimism in the AI sector, driven in part by Democratic wins in US midterm elections that promise greater regulation and a slower, costlier AI buildout. Sentiment was further impaired on Wednesday by the Trump administration's proposed new tariffs on imports from 14 trading partners and data showing US inflation increased further in October.

But the selling, which began soon after the Nasdaq Composite's record high on October 6 and increased markedly in the second half of November, also underscored gathering concern about the financial underpinnings of an infrastructure expansion that has increasingly been financed by large sales of debt — a practice that tends to make markets more fragile and vulnerable to reversal.
Overnight in Tokyo, OpenAI shareholder SoftBank fell 14 per cent, underscoring fears that ChatGPT maker OpenAI may face increasing resistance as it seeks to raise money. SoftBank, also a major investor in chip firm Arm, is down more than 40 per cent for the year.
Nvidia, a major OpenAI partner in data centers and other aspects of the AI ecosystem, dropped 8.5 per cent to a fresh low before ending 3.9 per cent lower. The so-called neocloud firms that back AI data center capacity were under renewed attack, reflecting in part concern about their capacity to raise funds to support ambitious building plans.
"It seems that these companies are trying to one-up each other on the amount of money that they're spending, but you have to show that it's worth it, and that's where Wall Street is saying, 'I don't know'," said Todd Schoenberger, chief investment officer at CrossCheck Management.
HEADING INTO BEAR TERRITORY
The Nasdaq-100 briefly fell 20 per cent below its October 6 record closing high. The worries about the underpinnings of the AI boom were so significant that even firms reporting strong results were caught in the downdraft, reflecting in part their large stock-price gains earlier in the year. Dell Technologies fell 5.7 per cent early on Wednesday despite the server maker raising its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year and approving an additional $25 billion share buyback. Dell stock recovered to rise 0.6 per cent and has more than doubled for the year.
Rival AI server maker HPE tumbled 16.3 per cent on Tuesday after raising its full-year revenue outlook. Shares of Ambarella, valued at $2 billion, tumbled 20.9 per cent after the AI semiconductor firm forecast fourth-quarter revenue below analysts' estimates.
The Philadelphia chips index slid 7 per cent to hit a more than seven-month low before closing 0.6 per cent lower. The index has plunged more than 43 per cent from its record high in June. Shares of AI hyperscalers were broadly lower, with Oracle down 5 per cent and Amazon.com off 3 per cent.
Nvidia-backed neocloud firms CoreWeave and Nebius Group fell more than 10 per cent each, before CoreWeave closed flat and Nebius down 2.7 per cent, while IREN, Applied Digital and Core Scientific were mostly narrowly mixed after early declines.
Neocloud providers, which rent out specialized AI computing capacity, have been under pressure since October over concerns about the debt funding their rapid expansion.
The yield on CoreWeave's bonds due 2031 rose to almost 18 per cent as prices fell nearly 2 cents on the dollar to near record lows, Tradeweb data showed.
The cost of insurance against tech companies defaulting on debts has jumped sharply, with five-year CDS spreads at Oracle, Alphabet, SpaceX and CoreWeave hitting record levels.

Source: Reuters

items.title: US military pause clouds Ecuador’s illegal mining fight
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.summary: A Pentagon probe raises uncertainty over efforts to combat criminal gangs that have infiltrated Ecuador’s gold supply chain.
items.body:
US military pause clouds Ecuador’s illegal mining fight
A Pentagon probe raises uncertainty over efforts to combat criminal gangs that have infiltrated Ecuador’s gold supply chain.

Cecilia Jamasmie
|
November 25, 2026 - 6:37 am

Categories:
Copper
Gold
Regulatory Issues
South America
United States

Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa meets US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. ( Image courtesy of Hegseth | X. )

Ecuador’s Interior Minister John Reimberg reaffirmed the country’s security partnership with Washington following reports that the Trump administration had suspended joint military operations, raising uncertainty over efforts to combat drug trafficking and illegal mining.

Talks last week with US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth focused on reviewing operations, determining next steps and identifying Ecuador’s operational needs, Reimberg said in a radio interview Wednesday, Reuters reported. He described the discussions as productive, pointing to an established action plan between the two countries.

“Some would like to see these relationships, which have yielded so many positive results, damaged,” Reimberg said.

The remarks follow reports Tuesday by The New York Times and The Atlantic that Washington halted joint operations in mid-October. The US Department of Defense reportedly launched an investigation into alleged human rights violations during a Sept. 23 operation by Ecuadorian forces in Manabí province that killed a suspected criminal leader.

The reported suspension comes at a critical juncture for Ecuador, which in July elevated illegal mining to a national security threat after concluding that criminal gangs had infiltrated the country’s gold supply chain, turning the sector into a major source of financing for organized crime.

Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa and Hegseth discussed expanding technological assistance, port security and border surveillance during last week’s visit. However, no new agreement was signed amid domestic political sensitivities ahead of the Nov. 29 local elections.

Noboa announced in March that Ecuador would conduct joint operations with the US and other allies, describing the initiative as “a new phase” in the fight against narco-terrorism and illegal mining. While the initiative has garnered public support, Ecuadorians voted last year against allowing foreign military bases on national territory.

Criminal gold

Ecuador’s 2026–2029 National Security Plan identifies illegal mining as a strategic security challenge rather than simply an environmental or regulatory issue.

The government says criminal organizations use illicit gold production to launder drug trafficking proceeds while supplying mining operations with machinery, chemicals and armed protection.

Gangs hijack Ecuador’s gold mining supply chain

The strategy reflects growing concern over the profitability of illicit gold production, which is fuelling violence and environmental destruction while exposing vulnerabilities in Ecuador’s mineral supply chain.

The plan identifies Los Lobos as the country’s dominant criminal organization in illegal mining. A report by the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) similarly concludes that the gang operates across the gold value chain, from extraction to exports through the ports of Guayaquil and Puerto Bolívar.

Regional resistance

The Trump administration’s push to expand military co-operation under its American Coalition Against the Cartels faces political obstacles elsewhere in Latin America, where governments must balance security priorities with concerns over sovereignty and the legacy of US military interventions.

During Hegseth’s recent trip, Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella told Washington he lacked congressional support to authorize joint military operations, The New York Times reported.

Nearly 70% of Ecuador’s protected areas are located in the Napo province, where most illegal miners are active.

De La Espriella denied the report , while Hegseth said on X that the alliance between the two countries was “stronger than ever.”

Adam Isacson, a security expert at the Washington Office on Latin America, said the suspension in Ecuador and the lukewarm reception Hegseth received from right-wing governments suggested the Trump administration’s strategy of conducting joint strikes across the region was “losing momentum.”

The Pentagon maintained in a statement to the NYT that US military officers remained “committed to working alongside sovereign partners, including Ecuador, to confront narco-terrorist networks.”

(With files from Reuters)

WASHINGTON: United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday (Nov 25) fired a new tariff salvo on 14 major trading partners, including China, Japan, the European Union and Singapore, undeterred in his protectionist push by the losses his Republican Party suffered in US midterm elections .
His administration proposed new headline tariff rates of 20 per cent to 40 per cent, but said duties would be capped at lower levels agreed under trade deals that have already been concluded or remain under negotiation.
Under the main "Section 301" probe into excess industrial capacity, China would face the highest capped rate of 20 per cent, which would be added to duties of roughly 25 per cent imposed during Trump's first term.
That rate would comply with a US-China trade truce that expires on January 10. But if the truce unravels, China's rate would rise to 40 per cent, the United States Trade Representative (USTR) said.
